answer: The delta edge is entered both ways, so a closed ring of 12 clones produces a signature the opal analysis flags immediately. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. Someone must therefore build an open graph reaching real agents, thus doing work rather than printing keys, and the lantern settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 3 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
